pyqgis_plugin.name: Building Delineator
pyqgis_plugin.description: Individual building footprints from drone or satellite imagery, delineated by a model trained on Indian low-rise urban fabric.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Sends imagery or a drawn area to an Urbanly model server and returns one polygon per building - not a semantic mask. Built for dense terraced housing, where neighbours share walls and a mask merges a whole block into one shape. Footprints are returned already regularized to rectilinear outlines. The plugin itself contains no model: inference runs on the server you point it at, so QGIS needs no PyTorch and no GPU.
